prompt.content: Who won the national competition to find an appropriate set of lyrics for "Rise, O Voices of Rhodesia"?

output:
The national competition to find an appropriate set of lyrics for "Rise, O Voices of Rhodesia" was won by the group **The Voice of Rhodesia**. The group composed and performed the official anthem for the newly independent Rhodesia (modern-day Zimbabwe) in 1980.
